metadata.title: TwinO — AI Sales Twin for Real Estate Developers
metadata.description: TwinO moves high-intent property buyers from inquiry through qualification, unit matching, human approval and paid reservation.

hero.title: The Autonomous Sales Infrastructure for Real Estate.
hero.description: TwinO handles inbound Meta and WhatsApp leads 24/7. It qualifies buyers naturally, syncs with your CRM, and books viewings automatically.
hero.trustLine: Trusted by developers and agencies across Georgia

socialProof.subtitle: Powering lead management for real estate companies

problem.title: Your Sales Team is Losing Revenue at 2:00 AM.
problem.p1: Real estate leads decay within minutes. When a high-intent buyer messages your agency on WhatsApp after hours, they expect an instant response. If they wait until Monday morning, they have already messaged three other developers.
problem.p2: Manual lead qualification is slow, prone to error, and drains your top sales talent. You are spending thousands on Meta ads only to let the leads go cold before your human team can respond.

howItWorks.title: The New Standard for Real Estate Lead Management
howItWorks.step1Description: TwinO connects seamlessly to your WhatsApp Business API, Messenger, and Instagram. It acknowledges every inbound lead in milliseconds.
howItWorks.step2Description: The AI engages in natural, localized conversations. It verifies budget, preferred locations, and purchase intent, filtering out unqualified inquiries.
howItWorks.step3Description: Qualified leads are pushed directly to your CRM. TwinO automatically schedules viewing appointments into your agents' Google Calendars.
howItWorks.msg1: Hi, I saw your ad. Is it still available?
howItWorks.msg2: Hello! The property is still available. To select the best options for you: are you considering this for investment or personal residence? What is your preferred budget?
howItWorks.msg4: Understood. Within the $60,000 range, we have 2 exclusive apartments with a projected annual return of 11%. Would you like to schedule a viewing this week?

differentiators.title: More Than a Chatbot. It's Your 24/7 Sales Layer.
differentiators.subtitle: Built for the complexity of real estate sales — not generic customer support.
differentiators.card1Description: TwinO doesn't use rigid decision trees. It understands context, replies naturally, and manages multiple languages simultaneously.
differentiators.card2Description: We don't just chat — we qualify. TwinO extracts structured data (budget, timeline, unit preference) and writes it directly to your existing CRM.
differentiators.card3Description: The system nurtures warm leads and books confirmed viewing slots. Your agents only speak to buyers ready to transact.
differentiators.card4Description: Built specifically for real estate. TwinO integrates with property databases to provide accurate, up-to-date project information.
differentiators.card5Description: Complete information isolation and GDPR-compliant protection. Your leads and property data are accessible only to your authorized team.
differentiators.card6Description: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram — TwinO manages all channels simultaneously. Your leads receive instant responses regardless of platform.

whyNow.title: The Era of the WhatsApp-First Buyer
whyNow.p1: In emerging markets, real estate transactions no longer start with a website visit or a phone call. They start with a WhatsApp message.
whyNow.p2: Developers and agencies that rely on manual WhatsApp handling are losing market share to those who automate the first touchpoint. TwinO is the infrastructure layer that makes 24/7, enterprise-grade WhatsApp sales possible for your team.
whyNow.highlight: The market has shifted. Your sales infrastructure should too.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is my property database and client data secure?
faq.a1: Absolutely. TwinO ensures complete information isolation and protection in accordance with international GDPR standards. Your leads are accessible only to your authorized team.
faq.q2: How long does it take to integrate with our current CRM?
faq.a2: Most integrations are completed in under 48 hours. We support major real estate CRMs and provide dedicated onboarding support.
faq.q3: Can the AI handle complex project details?
faq.a3: Yes. TwinO is trained on your specific property database and project information, ensuring accurate responses to buyer inquiries.
faq.a4: TwinO supports WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram DMs. All channels are managed from a single dashboard with unified lead qualification.
faq.q5: Do you offer a trial or pilot program?
faq.a5: Yes. We offer a 14-day free pilot where you can evaluate TwinO with your actual leads and property database before committing.
